title: An Entropic Factor Model for Robust Portfolio Replication
abstract: arXiv:2609.03552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio replication, or the construction of a tradable basket of assets to match the risk-return profile of a target benchmark, is fundamentally an ill-posed inverse problem. When restricted to a subset of available assets, classical variance-minimizing models often yield unstable, over-leveraged portfolios highly vulnerable to market shocks. We propose a unified, two-stage methodology rooted in information theory to achieve robust portfolio replication. First, we model the constituent asset returns against target factors, estimating parameters within data-driven empirical bounds via an entropy minimization principle. Second, using the same entropic approach, we determine the optimal weight replication. In both cases we use an entropy function of the Fermi-Dirac type defined directly on sets of constraints of the inverse problem. translated_title: 用于稳健投资组合复制的熵因子模型
translated_abstract: 投资组合复制，即构建一个可交易的资产篮子以匹配目标基准的风险收益特征，本质上是一个不适定的逆问题。当资产选择被限制在可用资产的子集时，经典的方差最小化模型往往产生不稳定、过度杠杆化的投资组合，极易受市场冲击的影响。我们提出了一种基于信息理论的统一两阶段方法来实现稳健的投资组合复制。第一阶段，我们针对目标因子对成分资产收益进行建模，通过熵最小化原理在数据驱动的经验界限内估计参数；第二阶段，使用相同的熵方法确定最优的权重复制。在这两个阶段中，我们使用直接定义在逆问题约束集上的费米-狄拉克型熵函数。我们在五个数值实验（摘要在此处截断）上，将该熵因子模型（EFM）与标准普通最小二乘法（OLS）进行了对比验证。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于费米-狄拉克型熵函数的两阶段熵因子模型（EFM），通过熵最小化原理在数据驱动的经验界限内估计参数并确定最优权重，克服了传统方差最小化模型在投资组合复制中产生不稳定、过度杠杆化投资组合的缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a two-stage Entropic Factor Model (EFM) that uses a Fermi-Dirac type entropy function and entropy minimization to estimate parameters within data-driven empirical bounds and determine optimal weights, overcoming the instability and over-leveraging of classical variance-minimizing approaches in robust portfolio replication.
